chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād narrated from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Where is this blow to be struck?—meaning, concerning one who has intercourse with a mahram relative. He said: “His neck is to be struck,” or he said: “His neck.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, a kunyah for Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الضَّرْبَةَ: the blow; here referring to the execution strike
key_terms.ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ: a woman who is within the prohibited degrees of kinship for marriage
key_terms.رَقَبَتُهُ: his neck; an alternative wording conveying the same meaning
key_terms.عُنُقُهُ: his neck; the place where the strike is carried out
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: is to be struck; indicates the implementation of a penal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment mentioned by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام for one who has intercourse with a mahram relative?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the prescribed punishment for one who commits intercourse with a mahram relative. The Imam عليه السلام states that the strike is to be delivered to the neck, indicating execution in this grave case.
